label: Gaius

text.NESTLE1904 3JN 1:1: Ὁ πρεσβύτερος Γαΐῳ τῷ ἀγαπητῷ, ὃν ἐγὼ ἀγαπῶ ἐν ἀληθείᾳ.
text.KJV 3JN 1:1: The elder unto the wellbeloved Gaius, whom I love in the truth.
text.NESTLE1904 3JN 1:2: Ἀγαπητέ, περὶ πάντων εὔχομαί σε εὐοδοῦσθαι καὶ ὑγιαίνειν, καθὼς εὐοδοῦταί σου ἡ ψυχή.
text.KJV 3JN 1:2: Beloved, I wish above all things that thou mayest prosper and be in health, even as thy soul prospereth.

A.name: Gaius
family: companion-of aristarchus (Aristarchus, Paul's traveling companion from Macedonia (ACT 19:29))

B.name: Gaius
B.line: The wellbeloved addressee of the Third Epistle of John.

why: The Greek addresses “Γαΐῳ τῷ ἀγαπητῷ” (the beloved Gaius), matching B’s stated identity as the addressee of Third John; verse 2 continues addressing him as “Beloved.” Nothing here identifies him as Paul’s Macedonian traveling companion, A.
